messages.subject: spam email issue (moderating recent subscribers)
parts:
hi all,
  I had to set recent subscribers to the group to 'moderated', because I think a bunch of spambots subscribed to the email list before I changed the settings last week.  If you find that you're one of the moderated emails if you try to post, I will unmoderate you once I confirm you're a real person.
 Sorry for the spam you've been getting!
regards
andy
